commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat tests/test_tasks.py docs/export-notes.md && python3 --version && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
pages = [Path('README.md'), Path('AGENTS.md'), Path('CLAUDE.md'), *Path('docs/knowledge').rglob('*.md')]
count = 0
for page in pages:
    for target in re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', page.read_text()):
        path, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        destination = page.parent / path if path else page
        assert destination.is_file(), (page, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'"'^#+ (.+)$'"', destination.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = [re.sub(r'["'^'"\\w -]', '', heading.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for heading in headings]
            assert anchor in slugs, (page, target)
        count += 1
print(f'Validated {count} local documentation links across {len(pages)} pages.')
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short && git diff -- README.md tasklist tests docs/export-notes.md'
